remarks: Freshly painted & move-in ready, this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bath ranch-style end unit is ideally situated in desirable West Norwalk. A truly exceptional rental, nestled in a private, serene setting along the Five Mile River, offering the perfect blend of peace & convenience. The bright & spacious open-concept floor plan showcases a beautifully renovated kitchen featuring brand-new cabinetry & modern appliances, seamlessly flowing into the living & dining areas. Add'l highlights include hardwood flooring, crown molding, recessed lighting, & 9+ ft ceilings. The inviting living room is complemented by a decorative fireplace, adding charm. The primary suite features a generous walk-in closet & a private en-suite bath. A second bedroom & adjacent hallway full bath provide flexibility for guests or a home office. Additional features include central air, a newer in-unit washer/dryer, new blinds, & a newer furnace. This unit offers 2 reserved parking spaces in a gated garage & a large private storage unit. The secure elevator building features a call-box entry system, visitor parking, & beautifully maintained outdoor spaces. Enjoy a prime commuter location just minutes from I-95, the Merritt Parkway, & Metro-North Railroad. Convenient to all that Norwalk & Darien have to offer, including Historic SoNo, The SoNo Collection Mall, restaurants, nightlife, & Oak Hills Golf Course. A short drive to Cranbury Park & Calf Pasture Beach. Strong credit required. Agents, please see remarks.
